D.t: Kweisi Mfume leads by 69.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 208,972 votes; a one point swing is about 1,515 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +64.7 and D +73.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
